  (select source.date from exams source where source.id = "grades"."exam_id"))
          and (placement.valid_to is null or placement.valid_to > coalesce(
  (select source.date from assessments source where source.id = "grades"."assessment_id"),
  (select source.date from exams source where source.id = "grades"."exam_id")))
